description:
The pages AI engines cite where the brand isn't — listicles, directories, reviews, forums, news, videos, competitors' pages — from the site's audits, as outreach targets: typed, checked for whether they name or link the brand, ranked by leverage, each with a next step. Asks no engine.

Billing: 10¢ per site per 24h; repeats and other filters that day are free. Not billed when nothing in scope was lost (no_data, nothing_lost, no_sources) or on an error.

When to call: after get_audit shows lost prompts, or when asked where to get listed or why AI cites other sites.

Returns { scope, summary: {lost_cells, prompts_lost, cited_pages, by_type, brand_absent_on}, targets: [{rank, url, host, type, competitor, brand_on_page, title, submit_url, own_listing?, dated_prompts?, lost_prompts, engines, example_prompts, leverage, why, next_step: {action, detail, tool?, args?}}], more_targets, notes, charged_cents }. type: listicle | review_site | directory | forum | news | article | video | social | company_page | docs | reference | other. brand_on_page: linked | mentioned | absent | unknown | not_checked (top 15 fetched). Outreach is the user's call: present targets, draft a pitch only when asked, save the pick with update_site_brief.

audit_id.description: Read only this audit (list_sites' latest_audit.audit_id). Omit for every audit in the window.

domain.description: The site's domain as added to AuditAE, e.g. "acme.com". Or pass site_id.

engines.description: Only these engines' answers. Default: all.

site_id.description: AuditAE site id from list_sites. Or pass domain.

types.description: Only these page types, e.g. ["listicle", "directory"]. Default: all.

window_days.description: Days of audit history to read, default 90. Ignored with audit_id.

name: find_citation_sources
title: Find the pages AI engines cite instead of the brand, as outreach targets
